summary: Full E2E health sweep (iteration 14). BACKEND: new pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_full_sweep.py = 62/64 pass; legacy suites 96 pass / 1 skip. All core gameplay, cashier, admin/HQ and support endpoints work. 2 genuine backend failures (no brute-force lockout, wildcard CORS with credentials). FRONTEND: auth (register + admin login), flagship spin, basic spin, Keno live board, daily wheel, tournament, cashier, HQ inbox and mobile 390x844 all PASS. However the 'premium look' goal is NOT met: 10 lobby tiles render literally BROKEN images (naturalWidth=0 - assets are 95-byte 1x1 transparent PNGs saved with a .jpg extension), a further 74 of 134 tiles have no at all (flat dark-green gradient cards, zero artwork), and the lobby hero carousel key art for inferno_airstrike / pharaohs_arsenal is a text-on-solid placeholder SVG. The 22 NEW AAA flagships are the good news: all 22 present in /api/games/slots and all 22 render a real, non-broken tile image - but the generated JPGs carry a baked-in AI watermark ('MOBILE SLOT GAME' is legible on the solar_vanguard emblem in the TAP-TO-START splash).

critical.issue: No brute-force lockout. 6 consecutive wrong passwords for the same account all return 401 (codes=[401,401,401,401,401,401]); expected 423/429 after 5 failures per the auth playbook. No attempt counter / lock field in the users doc. Credential-stuffing is unthrottled.

allow_origin_regex='.*' together with allow_credentials=True. A POST from Origin: https://evil.example.com is answered with Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * AND Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true. Playbook requires an explicit origin allow-list; with httpOnly session cookies this is a CSRF vector (and browsers reject '*' + credentials outright, so real cross-origin cookie auth is silently broken).

minor.issue: Fired on every page load before the token is hydrated -> a 401 on every route change. Cosmetic console noise but shows up in every browser session.

ui_bugs.issue: 10 tiles render with img.naturalWidth === 0 (browser cannot decode) = visibly blank cards. Root cause: /app/frontend/public/slots/thumb_{aurora,celestial,forge,midnight,nebula,neon,oasis,storm,titan,valley}.jpg (and the matching bg_*.jpg) are 95-byte 1x1 TRANSPARENT PNGs given a .jpg extension. Affected slots (all is_flagship=true): aurora_strike, nebula_fortune, titan_city, valley_of_echoes, neon_reserve, celestial_forge, forge_of_the_lost, oasis_relics, stormbreaker, midnight_harvest. 11 more non-flagship slots point at the same dead files: dollar_storm, seven_seven_crazy, fire_of_villa_street, book_of_wizard, eyes_of_fortune, magic_totem, reactoonz, aladdin, golden_lotus, golden_rooster, peace_and_long_life.

74 of 134 tiles contain no element at all and fall back to a plain radial dark-green gradient (verified: lobby-slot-mega_moolah has only 'radial-gradient(120% 120% at 50% 0%, rgb(10,31,10), rgb(10,13,10))'). These ids are absent from both FLAGSHIP_ART and BASE_MACHINE_ART in gameMeta.js, and resolveMachineArt's '/slots/thumb_gold.jpg' fallback is never applied because the card only renders an when an art entry exists. Includes 10 is_flagship slots: crimson_circuit, five_dragons_ultra_grand, vortex_vanguard, night_ops_kingpin, thunder_titans, diamond_commando, ironclad_jackpots, stormfront_seven, brigade_of_gold, blackout_royal (plus midnight_vanguard, redline_reign, wild_bandito, triple_gold_twister, dragon_lightning_link, game_of_thrones, buffalo_gold_rush, five_kings, queen_of_the_nile and ~55 classics: mega_moolah, divine_fortune, book_of_dead, starburst, sweet_bonanza, wolf_gold, cleopatra, gonzo_quest, thunderstruck_ii, buffalo, dancing_drums, sun_of_egypt*, etc.). Net effect: ~84/134 lobby tiles carry no artwork.

Hero slides for inferno_airstrike and pharaohs_arsenal render as a flat maroon panel with giant ghost outline text and no key art, because their art points at /slots/thumb_inferno_aaa.svg (916 B) and /slots/thumb_dynasty_aaa.svg (806 B) - both are placeholder text-on-solid SVGs, not artwork. Additionally the cross-fade shows TWO slides' titles simultaneously ('INFERNO AIRSTRIKE' overlapping 'PHARAOH'S ARSENAL'), which reads as a rendering glitch on the very first thing a visitor sees.

60 symbol files /slots/symbols/{aurora,celestial,forge,midnight,nebula,neon,oasis,storm,titan,valley}_sym_1..6.svg are 193-byte placeholders: a #111 square with white text ('NE1', 'OA3', ...). Any of the 21 slots in that theme family that render symbol art will show debug text instead of symbols.

The generated tile JPGs contain baked-in AI watermark text. On /slots/solar_vanguard the TAP-TO-START splash renders tile_solar_vanguard.jpg at full size and the words 'MOBILE SLOT GAME' are clearly legible on the central emblem. All 22 new tiles should be visually audited for embedded text.

The 'WAGES OF WAR' wordmark next to [data-testid="nav-logo"] wraps to 3 lines (measured 94x84 px) inside a ~56px header, so the first line is clipped above the viewport and the block collides with the mute button / balance chip. Needs a truncate/shrink or icon-only brand under sm.

Renders 'Min withdraw $$13.2 - Max withdraw $$16500' (double dollar sign). Cashier.jsx:343 - the template already prefixes '$' and then interpolates `$${meta.min_withdraw_usd}`. Also the limits themselves are unrounded FX conversions ($6.6 / $3300 / $13.2 / $16500) which looks unpolished for a premium brand.

Uncaught PAGEERROR: "Failed to execute 'createRadialGradient' on 'CanvasRenderingContext2D': The r1 provided is less than 0." from CombatBackground.jsx:171 (explosion radius e.r goes negative). The throw happens inside the requestAnimationFrame loop, so the animated background silently dies for the rest of the session. Clamp with Math.max(0, e.r) and clamp dt.
Copyright reads '(c) 2025 Wages of War Operations Ltd.' (now 2026) and the compliance block still contains the literal placeholder 'Registered Address: [Registered Address]'.

issues: Two visual tiers side by side: the ~50 AAA tiles look premium, the other ~84 are empty dark-green gradient boxes or blank broken images. The grid reads as unfinished.
10 broken tiles show as pure empty frames with only the title text.
Currency picker is the browser-default native <select> ('A$ AUD - Australian Dollar'), not the shadcn Select used elsewhere - breaks visual consistency.

Symbols are generic geometric primitives (purple diamond, teal circle, hourglass, trophy) identical across every flagship theme - no theming for solar_vanguard vs jade_dynasty etc. Functional, but not 'AAA'.
Top ticker banner consumes 2 lines of an already short viewport.

critical_code_review_comments: gameMeta.js: resolveMachineArt() has a sensible '/slots/thumb_gold.jpg' fallback but the Lobby card only emits an when an art entry exists, so the fallback never fires - 74 ids silently degrade to a bare gradient. Either always render resolveMachineArt(id).thumb, or add an onError handler that swaps to the fallback (that would also mask the 10 broken 1x1 assets).

Asset pipeline has no validation gate: 20 files are 1x1 transparent PNGs with a .jpg extension and 60 more are 193-byte text-label SVGs. Add a build/CI check that every referenced asset decodes and is above a minimum byte size + minimum dimensions.

backend/server.py is 3069 lines and games.py is 4802 lines - both far over the 700-line guideline. games.py is essentially one giant data blob plus RNG; split the SLOT_MACHINES catalogue into its own data module and move keno/wheel/tournament routers out of server.py.
CORS allow_origin_regex='.*' with allow_credentials=True is a security defect, not a convenience - it must be an explicit env-driven allow-list.
No login attempt throttling anywhere in the auth path; add a per-email + per-IP counter with a lockout window.

CombatBackground.jsx: the RAF callback does unguarded canvas math (createRadialGradient with a possibly negative radius). One throw permanently stops the animation; wrap the frame body in try/catch and clamp radii/dt.

Positive: seed_admin is correctly idempotent - it inserts when absent and only rewrites password_hash when verify_password fails; admin hash confirmed to start with $2b$; login sets an HttpOnly access_token cookie. All three playbook checks pass.

rca_of_the_issue: Blank tiles: 20 files in /app/frontend/public/slots (thumb_/bg_ for aurora, celestial, forge, midnight, nebula, neon, oasis, storm, titan, valley) are 95-byte 1x1 transparent PNGs carrying a .jpg extension - a failed/aborted asset generation step. Chromium reports naturalWidth 0 for them, so the paints nothing and the tile is an empty frame. Separately, 74 slot ids were added to backend PUBLIC_SLOT_IDS without a matching FLAGSHIP_ART / BASE_MACHINE_ART entry in gameMeta.js; because the Lobby card conditionally renders the only when an art entry exists, resolveMachineArt's thumb_gold.jpg fallback never executes and those cards degrade to a bare gradient. Both are asset/data-completeness gaps, not runtime logic bugs - every gameplay and API path exercised in this sweep behaved correctly.
